Amended of Sec.1,Sec.7, distribution of collections; 85% allotted to the Special Road Support Fund (5% Special Local Road Fund, 5% Special Road Safety Fund, 5% Special Vehicle Pollution Control Fund)
The Special Road Support Fund shall be allocated to each Congressional district including party list in equal amounts of 20 Million/Representative and 60 Million/Senator intended for maintenance, repair, improvement and concreting of all roads (national/provincial/city/municipal/barangays).
The 15% of the Special Road Support Fund shall be allocated as contingency fund to be managed by the Road Board.
Sec.2.Sec.8 amended with the 4 special funds shall be distinct and separate from and in addition to any appropriation authorized and granted yearly to DPWH/DOTC and members of Congress to cover expenditures for the identified objects of expenditures under this Act.
